items.title: 5.1.2 Role of Models in Decision-Making (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Topic 5.1.2 (PDF 127, printed 124).

blocks.text: Models is liye mufeed hain ke yeh kisi masle par sochne ka ek munazzam (structured) tareeqa dete hain. Yeh complicated maloomat ko aasan bana dete hain. Faisla karne (decision making) mein yeh khaas taur par aham hai, kyun ke model se hum faisle se pehle mukhtalif nataij (outcomes) par ghaur kar sakte hain.

Misal: Ek kisan model istemal kar ke tay karta hai ke fasal bone ka behtareen waqt kaunsa hai. Mausam ke patterns aur mitti ki halat dekh kar model sahi waqt ka andaza lagata hai, jis se achhi fasal ka imkan barhta hai.

blocks.prompt: Asal duniya ke masail hal karne mein statistical models ka kirdar aur ahmiyat samjhaiye. (Long question 1)
blocks.explanation: Statistical model purane data se batata hai ke variables aapas mein kaise jure hain, is liye naye cases ki pesh-goi kar sakta hai. Yeh complex soorat ko munazzam karta hai (jaise customers aur kamai, ya parhai ke ghante aur nataij), faisle se pehle mukhtalif nataij ka muwazna karne deta hai (kab bona hai, kitna stock rakhna hai), ghalti (error) naap kar batata hai ke andaza kitna pakka hai, aur naye data par jaancha jata hai ta ke faisle saboot par hon. Istemal: mausam ki pesh-goi, maali andaze aur scientific tehqeeq. Model fair (munsif) hona chahiye aur privacy ka khayal rakhna chahiye.

items: Models maloomat ko munazzam karte hain aur faisle se pehle nataij ka muwazna karne dete hain (kisan ka bone ka waqt).
